sections.label: The opening
sections.para: Provenance at the end of a chapter is the right information at the wrong time; the book becomes one source in layers projected to web, iPad and print with QR codes; precedents show old mechanisms and failed platforms; the research favours notes next to the claim.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Seven lines on the augmented book
sections.para: The wrong time; layers; three projections; the reader in control; old mechanisms; failed platforms; the research.

sections.label: The right information at the wrong time
sections.line: The right information at the wrong time
sections.para: Where this comes from is the provenance, but at a chapter's end it is too much, words without connection, and too little, because nothing links.

sections.label: One source, in layers
sections.para: The text, what opens on demand, the provenance of each claim and the record behind it; the site already folds sections and keeps graphs and versions.

sections.label: Three projections
sections.para: The web links everything and lets the reader choose; the iPad shows layers on the page; print keeps the page clean with QR codes next to claims.

sections.label: Who has done this before
sections.para: Stretchtext, Voyager's Expanded Books, CommentPress, the MagicBook, X-Ray and Word Wise, Our Choice, page previews, Web Annotation, Quantum Country, iBooks Author, Gwern.net and LiquidText.

sections.label: What they teach us
sections.para: The mechanisms are old; single-platform engines fail; hand-built layers cost too much; QR codes should point at addresses we control; standards exist for notes.

sections.label: Attention is the budget
sections.para: Notes next to the claim, fewer and typed links, signals not repetition, and the reader deciding how much shows.

sections.label: What we will try
sections.para: Provenance in place on the web, QR codes in print, layers in the iPad app, typed links, and a measure of which layers readers open.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: A concept; precedents found through search and not opened; the research is mixed in places; smart glasses a direction; my interest.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: My voice memo of 31 October, and the search results for each precedent and study.
